raw_response: {"diagnosis":"The stale-event filter added on 2026-01-17 (DE-412), `ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 HOUR`, drops legitimate late-arriving POSTED transactions. Batches routinely carry events about 3 days old, so roughly 20-25% of each batch from batch 3 on is lost. txn_id is unique, so there are no duplicate replays that the filter could be meant to remove. I am removing the filter and keeping the POSTED status filter.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.72,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
